**Chinese name:** 小华半导体有限公司 (Xiǎohuá Bàndǎotǐ)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
The state-aligned 'MCU + OS' stack for信创, white goods and automotive body/power domains: scale (300M units/yr), full automotive safety certification chain, and captive specialty-fab backing — plus a February 2025 AUTOSAR pact with CETC's 普华 OS vendor that pairs domestic silicon with a domestic car OS.
:::

## What does this firm design?

General/motor/automotive/ultra-low-power 32-bit MCUs (HC32 lines) and supporting RTOS/AUTOSAR software.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | State-Backed Design House |
| **Founded** | 2021 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | HC32-family 32-bit MCUs: general control, motor, automotive (HC32A), ultra-low-power (HC32L); ~300M units/year shipped |
| **Node Sophistication** | Mature 55/40nm-class; anchored on CEC-affiliated 积塔 specialty fabs — node-agnostic by design; full IATF16949 + ASIL-D process certification, AEC-Q100 parts |
| **Entity List** | No |
